messages:
jen: Heads-up — starting a canary for runtime v2.4 in ~10m. This release emits a new response header `x-rw-catalog` used by Console for variant display and Router for smarter routing. Plan: wave1 = 10% for 20m, wave2 = 50% after health checks. Need API/Console/Router to opt-in or pin compatible variants.

deploy-bot: queued runtime:v2.4 wave1 (10%) -> ETA +10m. (canary-id: c-2026-6843) :robot_face:

pranav: Router currently whitelists known headers and will drop unknown ones. I'll prepare a short-lived relaxation to allow `x-rw-catalog` for the canary and pin a router variant that won't strip it. PR #4245 opened.

yuki: Console only reads the header behind a feature flag. I can enable the flag for the canary cohort only. Will also pin console image to a safe build for the test users.

tom: API gateway note — we don't change body schema, but the gateway has strict header validation in front of the API multiplexor. I'll add a pass-through rule for the header for the canary routes.

jen: Green criteria: p50 latency within +10% of baseline, error rate <0.05% on /v1/generate, console render errors <1% for the canary cohort. Ops, can you add a short eval set (canary-prompts) and watch the dashboards?

ops-shepherd: Added dashboards and an alert set. On-call tagged. Smoke eval hooked to the canary cohort. Rollback command & pins for quick action:
```
# rollback runtime immediately
deploy-bot rollback runtime v2.4 --immediate
# pin variants if needed
deploy-bot pin console=2026-03-20-safe api=2026-03-20-safe router=stable
```
Also have an unpin helper: `deploy-bot unpin router --force`.

pranav: Router PR merged, router pinned to "allow-x-rw-catalog" variant (commit abc123). Leaving the old behavior as stable for everyone else.

yuki: Enabled console feature flag for canary cohort at T+12m. Starting to get metrics.

deploy-bot: wave1 started -> 10% traffic to runtime:v2.4 (canary-id: c-2026-6843).

ops-shepherd: Observability update at +8m: console render errors increased from baseline 0.12% -> 0.6%. Still under 1% but trending up. Initiating canary hold for investigation. Recommend pausing wave2 pending analysis.

jen: Pausing wave2. Tom/Yuki — prefer rollback if you can't find a mitigation in 10m. Alternative mitigation: runtime config `emit_x_rw_catalog=false` to stop emitting header without a full rollback.

tom: Reverting the gateway pass-through change to see if the gateway change caused decoding noise in Console. Revert PR in flight.

pranav: Reverted router relaxation as well to eliminate layering changes (confirming revert deployed, 10:32 UTC).

ops-shepherd: After reverts, console errors fell back to 0.13% within 3m. Good signal that header pass-through churned routing/metrics. Recommend abort wave2 and fully roll back runtime v2.4 for now.

jen: Agreed. Aborting further waves. Executing rollback: `deploy-bot rollback runtime v2.4 --reason "unexpected console render errors"`. Will update release notes and open a follow-up RFC for a handshake protocol so headers are feature-flagged end-to-end before emitting.

yuki: Thanks — will keep the console flag staged and do a deeper trace on render paths.

jen: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: — filing post-action notes and follow-up work items.
